items.source:
NOTE: This method will not deserialize Strings returned by Lua scripts, as they may not be encoded with the same
serializer used here.
items.translation: 注意：此方法不会反序列化由 Lua 脚本返回的字符串，因为它们可能未使用此处所用的同一序列化器进行编码。

items.source: Connection package for Lettuce Redis client.
items.translation: 用于 Lettuce Redis 客户端的连接包。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source:
Represents a data type returned from Redis, currently used to denote the expected return type of Redis scripting
commands
items.translation: 表示从 Redis 返回的数据类型，当前用于表示 Redis 脚本命令的预期返回类型。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，这些常量按照声明顺序排列。
